source.title: Nightstone — Wowhead archived comment by 1115982, two Obsidium Ore prospecting batches

quote: I mined 1040 (52 stacks) of Obsidium Ore.
notes: Original player experiment: 1,040 Obsidium Ore split into two separate 520-ore batches, one prospected at 5pm. Each batch equals 104 five-ore prospects. The commenter speculates that time of day affects Nightstone yields; this is not verified as a game mechanic. Historical Cataclysm-era report; exact patch, collection date, profession stats and positive-cast counts not stated. The two batches are separate cohorts by the same player.
